name: dsh-plugin-vision
description: analyze_image tool for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 0.2, delegates 'seeing' to a local vision model so a text-only brain never has an image in its context.
_comment_dsh_tools: Pinned to the dsh 0.2 generation explicitly: npm's `latest` tag for @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools is still the old 0.0.1-rc.1, which imports a package that was never published. Run `pnpm install --ignore-scripts` in this folder. If you move dsh to a new minor line, move this range with it.
